document.name: Sonder School of Music Elmhurst
document.shortDescription: Private lessons and group music classes in Elmhurst for ages 3 and up, with weekday and weekend availability.
document.longDescription:
Sonder School of Music's official site describes an Elmhurst music school at 83-07 Grand Avenue offering private lessons, group classes, and ensemble coaching for ages 3 and up. The official programs page lists instruction in piano, strings, guitar, flute, saxophone, clarinet, drums, voice, ukulele, theory, composition, general music appreciation, recording, and more, plus an art program for enrolled students.

The official enroll page publishes current lesson availability of 2-8 PM on weekdays and 9 AM-5 PM on weekends, which supports weekday, weekend, morning, afternoon, evening, and after-school tags. The same page also publishes one-on-one music lesson pricing starting at $48 for a 30-minute lesson, so this listing stores pricePerClass as 48.

Sources: https://sonderous.com/ https://sonderous.com/programs/ https://sonderous.com/enroll/ https://sonderous.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/Lobby-3-1024x768.jpg
